def backend.resetInv (txb : Loc) (m : GoMap) (P : backend.BksPhys) (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent))
    (txb_ptr k_ptr v_ptr : Loc) (keys : List w64) (i : Nat) (m' : GMap w64 Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ P' B' kv vv,
      "%Hm'" ∷ ⌜m' = GMap.fmap Prod.fst P'⌝ ∗
        ("Hbbs" ∷ [∗map] x;es ∈ P';B', backend.bbAt x.fst (DFrac.own 1) x.snd es) ∗
          "%Hok" ∷
              ⌜∀ (id : w64) (x : Loc × backend.BBPhys) (es : List backend.Ent),
                  P' !! id = some x → B' !! id = some es → backend.bbOk x.snd es⌝ ∗
            "Htb" ∷ typedPointsto txb { buckets' := m } (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              "txb" ∷ typedPointsto txb_ptr txb (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                "k" ∷ typedPointsto k_ptr kv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                  "v" ∷ typedPointsto v_ptr vv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                    "%Hdone" ∷ ⌜∀ (j : w64), j ∈ List.take i keys → B' !! j = backend.bksReset B !! j⌝ ∗
                      "%Hrest" ∷ ⌜∀ (j : w64), ¬j ∈ List.take i keys → B' !! j = B !! j ∧ P' !! j = P !! j⌝)

theorem backend.bksReset_lookup (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) (j : w64) : backend.bksReset B !!
    j = Option.map (fun x => []) (Option.filter (fun es => !es.isEmpty) (B !! j))
